description_en: Deletes an IM group invitation link
kebab_example: aliyun cams delete-chat-group-invite-link --business-number 8613800000 --channel-type WHATSAPP --group-id E3980000 --cust-space-id cams-8000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteChatGroupInviteLink

parameters.help_en: The business phone number. You can view the business phone number by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932629.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 商家号码。可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932629.html接口查看商家号码
parameters.name: business_number

parameters.help_en:
The channel type. Valid values:

- **WHATSAPP**

> Only WhatsApp channel type messages are supported
parameters.help_zh:
类型。取值：

- **WHATSAPP**。

> 暂仅支持WhatsApp通道类型消息
parameters.name: channel_type

parameters.help_en: The group ID. You can view the group ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932629.html operation
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The SpaceId or instance ID of the ISV sub-customer. This is the channel ID, which can be viewed on the [Channel Management](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement) page
parameters.help_zh: ISV子客户的SpaceId/实例ID。即通道ID，在[通道管理](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)界面查看
parameters.name: cust_space_id
